name: Narrative / Adventure
description: Story first: branching choices, characters and a world to explore and interact with.

pillars.name: Story
pillars.vision: The narrative and how the player's choices shape it.

pillars.name: Branching
pillars.vision: How the story forks and comes back together.

pillars.name: Choices and Consequences
pillars.vision: Which choices matter, and how and when they pay off.

pillars.name: Exploration and Interaction
pillars.vision: Moving through scenes and examining or using things in them.

pillars.name: Characters
pillars.vision: The cast: who they are, how they change, and how they're performed.

pillars.name: Save State
pillars.vision: Story flags, persistence and keeping saves valid as the story changes.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
